description: Escort: Short Haul: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: Two freighters, one gate. Keep them alive between here and there.
The haulers are yours in {system}. {enemy} ships are working this lane.
Escort duty. Stay close and be rude to anything that approaches.
success: The freighters are through. {client} sends thanks and the fee.
Convoy delivered. Quiet on the way out, in the end.
failure: The convoy is lost. {client} will not be renewing.
Freighter down. The run is a failure.
radio-convoy: Convoy is formed on you. Gate bearing ahead.
Haulers are in position. Stay with them.
Both freighters ready. Do not leave them.
radio-more: More fighters on the tail. Do not let them near the freighters.
